notes.title: 3.8 update notice
notes.notes:
You support our players, I'm very sorry, let you wait a long time!

Originally, we planned to add several new roles to DLC, but because we couldn't persuade the partners, we can't launch DLC at present, and we can't provide achievements because of the lack of art;

Due to the requirements of partners, we have not returned this game, and the price in a few regions has been increased!!! Discount at the time of promotion!

The main contents of this update are as follows:

1. Optimization loading stuck problem, if there is still feedback!

2. The problem of optimizing acquisition rotation fixation has been changed to full random to balance resources!

3. The contact information of the main interface has been reduced to the lower left corner to avoid visual experience;

We are ready for a new game. It is planned to be an RPG porn game. Crowdfunding will be launched then! Hope to be able to supplement our previous two games in the plot and play method!!!
